 IIT Madras launches UDYOG finishing school to prepare graduates for biotech industry
 IIT Madras has launched UDYOG, an industry-oriented finishing school offering online courses, hands-on laboratory training and industry internship opportunities for biotechnology graduates.

 IIT Madras launches UDYOG finishing school to prepare graduates for biotech industry Chennai: Indian Institute of Technology Madras ( IIT Madras ) has launched an industry-oriented finishing school to equip young graduates with practical skills and professional competencies required by the biotechnology and biomanufacturing sectors.
‘ UDYOG ’ ( Upskilling and Development for Young Graduates ) aims to bridge the gap between academic education and industry requirements through a structured training pathway. It combines online courses, intensive laboratory training, pilot-scale exposure and opportunities for industry internships .
 Advt 
 The first batch of the Finishing School is scheduled to commence on January 18, 2027, and the early-bird registration closes on December 15, 2026.
The initiative is expected to support workforce development and contribute to India's ambitions to strengthen its bioeconomy through innovation, advanced manufacturing capabilities and specialised skills.
 The programme is intended for pre-final-year and final-year students, who are pursuing B.Tech., M.Tech. and M.Sc. degrees in biotechnology and allied disciplines, across all colleges and institutes in India.
Prof. V. Kamakoti, Director, IIT Madras, inaugurated ‘IITM-Biofoundry Finishing School – UDYOG’ in the presence of faculty, students, researchers and industry stakeholders.
 It is being launched through SynBioME – the IIT Madras-TICEL Biofoundry, which focuses on advancing biotechnology research, innovation, biomanufacturing and skill development. It is coordinated by Prof. Guhan Jayaraman, Professor, Department of Biotechnology, IIT Madras, who serves as the Principal Coordinator.
Addressing the launch event, Prof. V. Kamakoti, Director, IIT Madras, said, “AI also means Academia-Industry. It is becoming an absolute necessity that every discipline of Science and Engineering must look at this AI with care to make themselves relevant to the modern world. UDYOG is yet another effort taken by IIT Madras in this direction.”
 Advt 
 Further, Prof. Guhan Jayaraman, Principal Coordinator, SynBioME and faculty Department of Biotechnology, IIT Madras, added, “India’s biotechnology and biopharmaceutical sectors are expanding at a rapid place. This is leading to a growing demand for professionals with practical expertise in industrial processes, analytical techniques, process development and regulatory practices. UDYOG seeks to address this demand by complementing academic knowledge with industry-relevant training and exposure to real-world biomanufacturing practices.”
 THREE-STAGE TRAINING
The finishing school will follow a three-stage training pathway. The first stage comprises three months of online learning delivered through Centre for Outreach and Digital Education (CODE), IIT Madras, supplemented by lectures from industry experts and demonstration videos illustrating industrial practices.
 Participants who successfully complete the online component will be considered for selection to four-week intensive hands-on training program at the IIT Madras Biofoundry. The practical component is designed to provide exposure to laboratory processes and biomanufacturing workflows.
Following the hands-on training, selected participants may have opportunities to engage with industry partners and participate in interviews for long-term internships, providing a potential pathway from academic learning to workplace experience.
